about_blocks.text: Alberta Health Services (AHS) offers a variety of services to help residents improve their health and quality of life. One such service is Adult Detoxification High Prairie, which helps individuals who are struggling with drug and alcohol addictions detoxify safely and effectively.

One such service is Adult Detoxification High Prairie, which helps individuals who are struggling with drug and alcohol addictions detoxify safely and effectively.

about_blocks.text: The Adult Detoxification program consists of eight weekly sessions that take place over a period of two weeks. During the sessions, participants will receive individualized care tailored to their specific needs. They will also be supervised by licensed professionals throughout the process, so they can remain safe and secure while undergoing treatment.

about_blocks.text: A 24/7 Adult Detoxification service that helps people detoxifying from alcohol and other drugs in a safe, controlled setting. Services may include: withdrawal support assessment information sessions introduction to self-help groups addiction treatment planning discharge planning referral Admission is voluntary, confidential, and must be initiated by the client. Stop struggling with drug or alcohol addiction, Get in contact with Alberta Health Services for more information about the Adult Detoxification High Prairie program.
